rules.name: OCEAN IN PLAY
rules.text: You may add/move [Presence] into Oceans, but may not add/move [Presence] into Inland lands. On boards where you have 1 or more [Presence] , Oceans are treated as Coastal Wetlands for Spirit Powers and [Blight] . You Drown any Invaders or [Dahan] moved to those Oceans.
rules.turn:
spirit:special S ocean-in-play, add-presence S, ocean O / presence-dest S O
add-presence S, spirit:special S ocean-in-play, (presence-choice S C), !(coastal C)
ocean-in-play O / land-for power O
ocean-in-play O / land-for blight O
ocean-in-play O / terrain-for power O wetland
move P O, ocean-in-play O, piece:kind P K, human K, ~drown P
rules.evidence: Presence added into `sea` (never Inland l2/l3); push-dest offers `sea`; a pushed Town that lands in `sea` is drowned (drown *85, fear 1)
rules.notes: Each clause is one mechanism: widen the Presence choice (acc rows), narrow it (extra `!`), counts-as land per context (land-for power/blight), and a trigger on move. Needed core.t to read lands through land-for <context>, with one base line changed (cascade reads land-for blight). The FAQ says Fear/Event pushes cannot drown; push-dest is keyed by spirit, not by cause, so this is not modeled. First attempt never drowned: the `+human` facts were top-level and could not join the move episode.

rules.name: DROWNING
rules.text: Destroy Drowned pieces, placing Drowned Invaders here. At any time you may exchange (X) Health of these Invaders for 1 Energy, where X = number of players. (Ignore modifiers to Invader Health.)
rules.turn: drown P, ~>destroy P, piece:kind P K, invader K, ~move P ocean-mat
rules.evidence: drown *85; move *85 ocean-mat; fear 1 (destroying a Town still generates Fear, as the FAQ confirms)
rules.notes: "At any time you may exchange (X) Health ... for 1 Energy" is not modeled: Turn has no "at any time" construct, so the option would have to be offered at every choice point.

language_issues: Top-level `+` facts sit on a branch unordered with the game and silently never join with episodes inside it; they must live in setup.
No way to express an option available "at any time".
